children: HALF-TIME IN EUROPE: STUCK IN THE RED
We're just about half-way through the European trading day, and the STOXX 600
is still in the red - but only just. It has erased most of its earlier decline, last trading 0.1% lower.
is also just below the flatline, while the DAX
is meanwhile inching higher as it tries to build some momentum, supported by mining stocks.
Those are up 2.3% across Europe (.SXPP) at their highest since June, helped by surging metal prices. More on that in the copper post below.
Healthcare (.SXDP) names are at the bottom of the charts, falling 2%. The responsible party there is Novartis
which is having one of its biggest daily falls on record - last down 9.5% on the day after a second unsuccessful drug trial.

Helping stabilise the big picture is traders briefly taking some hope from a Qatar foreign ministry spokesperson saying that Qatar is working with partners in the region and around the world, including China, to resume talks between the United States and Iran.
